newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-DEBUTANT CROSSLEY KEEPS IRISH AT BAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DEBUTANT CROSSLEY KEEPS IRISH AT BAY.

text.p: A series of stunning saves by debutant Mark Crossley earned Wales a goalless draw in their friendly against Ireland on Tuesday.
The Nottingham Forest goalkeeper, deputising for veteran Neville Southall, made no slips after spilling a cross from Ian Harte early in the game.
A superb reflex save denied Wimbledon striker Jon Goodman a goal midway through the first half and late in the second half Crossley broke Irish hearts with three acrobatic saves in quick succession
He dived full length to turn a Goodman shot behind for a corner and then tipped headers by Tony Cascarino and substitute David Kelly over the bar.
Bolton's Keith Branagan, another debutant international, had less to do in the Ireland goal but he acquitted himself well.
His best save denied Arsenal striker John Hartson a goal in the second half.
